newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grinaker to announce restructuring Friday.
newsitem.headline: Grinaker to announce restructuring Friday.

text.p: South African industrial holding firm Grinaker Holdings Ltd has finalised a restructuring plan and will announce the details on Friday, managing director Jack Saulez told Reuters on Thursday.
Saulez declined to give any specifics of the plan but said it was now completed.
"There will be an announcement tomorrow (Friday), but it is subject to lots of approvals... but we have a story," he said.

The eagerly-awaited statement had been expected last week. However, the process proved more lengthy than expected and the company issued a cautionary statement telling shareholders to expect news this week.
Analysts expect the firm to announce an unbundling and separate listing of its investment in Grinaker Construction Ltd.

In August the firm said talks on restructuring links to its Siltek unit had ended, but that it was still mulling splitting off construction and a partial rationalisation of the current pyramid structure of the electronics units.
Analysts see unbundling construction as a positive step that would separate it from electronics businesses like Grintek, Siltek and Grinaker Electronics.
Many analysts see little business rationale linking the two halves of the holding firm.
